resyncAll.name: Resync everything
resyncAll.description: Re-fetches every IGDB-linked game's full catalog data (genres, companies, platforms, media, Collections, Series) — restores everything after a backup restore, which doesn't carry any of it over.

resyncGames.name: Resync Games
resyncGames.description: Re-fetches genres, companies, platforms, and media for every IGDB-linked game, without touching Collections or Series.

resyncCollections.name: Resync Collections
resyncCollections.description: Re-fetches only Collection data for every IGDB-linked game — restores Collections after a backup restore, which doesn't carry them over.

resyncSeries.name: Resync Series
resyncSeries.description: Re-fetches only Series data for every IGDB-linked game — restores Series after a backup restore, which doesn't carry it over.

steamImport.name: Steam import
steamImport.description: Fetches your Steam library and matches it to your catalog — nothing is added or changed automatically. Review and sync in Insights → Steam Sync.

itadRefresh.name: ITAD price refresh
itadRefresh.description: Refreshes sale prices and historical lows for wishlisted Windows/Mac/Linux/Android games via IsThereAnyDeal — powers the On Sale badges and Insights → On Sale.

platpricesRefresh.name: PlatPrices price refresh
platpricesRefresh.description: Refreshes sale prices for wishlisted PlayStation games via PlatPrices — powers the On Sale badges and Insights → On Sale.

tagManager.description: Permanently delete a tag. This removes it from every game, device, and accessory that has it — not just one item. To remove a tag from a single item instead, use the Tags field on that item's own page.

tagManager.deleteConfirmDescription_bulk_one: This permanently deletes the selected tag and removes it from every game, device, and accessory currently tagged with it. This cannot be undone.
tagManager.deleteConfirmDescription_bulk_other: This permanently deletes {{count}} selected tags and removes them from every game, device, and accessory currently tagged with them. This cannot be undone.

integrations.igdbDescription: IGDB credentials are configured via this server's <1>.env</1> file (<3>IGDB_CLIENT_ID</3> / <5>IGDB_CLIENT_SECRET</5>), not through the app.
integrations.steamDescription: The Steam API key is configured via this server's <1>.env</1> file (<3>STEAM_API_KEY</3>), not through the app. Get a free key at steamcommunity.com/dev/apikey, add it to .env, then restart VideoGameTrackarr.
integrations.steamIdHelperText: Your public SteamID64 — find it on your Steam profile page or via steamid.io. This isn't a secret; it's only used to look up your owned games.
integrations.saveErrorToast: Could not save SteamID64. Please try again.
integrations.itadDescription: The IsThereAnyDeal API key is configured via this server's <1>.env</1> file (<3>ITAD_API_KEY</3>), not through the app. Get a free key at isthereanydeal.com/apps/my, add it to .env, then restart VideoGameTrackarr.
integrations.platpricesDescription: The PlatPrices API key is configured via this server's <1>.env</1> file (<3>PLATPRICES_API_KEY</3>), not through the app. Get a key by applying at platprices.com/api-request (usually issued within 1-2 business days), add it to .env, then restart VideoGameTrackarr.
integrations.platpricesRegionCaveat: PlatPrices' free tier lets your account track any 2 PlayStation Store regions at a time (changeable once every 24 hours on platprices.com), plus 1,000 requests/month. Set PLATPRICES_REGION in .env to one of the 2 regions your account is currently tracking, or prices will reflect the wrong region's storefront.
integrations.platpricesCredit: PlayStation price data is powered by <1>PlatPrices</1>.
